solutions.title: Scan from the end
solutions.notes: Walk from end — O(1) extra space
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Skip trailing spaces from the end, then count until the next space.

**Complexity:** Time **O(n)**, space **O(1)**.

**Why preferred:** No allocation; natural once you think “start from the end.”

solutions.title: Split and findLast non-empty
solutions.description:
**Approach:** `split(" ")`, then `findLast` non-empty word and take `.length`.

**Complexity:** Time **O(n)**, space **O(n)** for the token array.

**vs recommended:** Easy to read. End-scan version is the usual interview follow-up for constant extra space.
